innovation_summary: Thermal-management core for Colossus-class AI compute: thermal-node and zone simulation, bounded anomaly detection and controller logic, a root CLI status path, and generation of DXF/PDF/SVG/PNG cooling blueprints. Its distinguishing engineering contribution is not the physics but the truth surface: a dedicated regression suite (tests/test_portfolio_truth_surface.py) that mechanically deletes unsupported public claims (100,000+ GPU coordination, zero-copy telemetry, live APEX Highway integration, production PUE/cost outcomes) and removes stale nonexistent paths, so the README cannot drift ahead of executed code. Two independent CI gates — a direct 'Cooling Core Truth Gate' and a reusable CI workflow driving the repository-owned scripts/ci/verify_portfolio_core.sh — both passed 37 tests at the exact head commit, with a hashed direct artifact. It is the canonical head of the 62-repository xAI/Colossus family and the first of five domains to cross a bounded executable promotion gate.
